parts.text: Which reply is correct about metals and non-metals in everyday life?

options.text: Non-metals are also essential, for example oxygen for breathing, nitrogen in fertilisers, and chlorine to purify drinking water.
Only metals matter, because tools and wires are the only everyday materials that count.
Every non-metal is needed in the same way in every home and factory.

parts.text: Give one reason for your choice.

stem: Farhan notices metal tools and wires everywhere in the school workshop. His teacher asks whether everyday life depends only on metals.

part_answers.answer: Metals are common in tools, but non-metals such as oxygen, nitrogen, and chlorine are also essential for breathing, fertilisers, and clean water.

teacher.key_rationale: Visible metal tools do not mean only metals matter. Non-metals such as oxygen, nitrogen, and chlorine are essential in everyday life.
